Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory598.jpg'}
{3: "The wind at the port began to rise. Cordelia touched the face of the child cradled in her arms, and the baby's warmth drew a soft smile from her."}
{3: 'The string of lights stretched out like a luminous river, winding toward the deep sea. Their warm white glow rocked gently with the waves, scattering shattered reflections across the water.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Storm's coming. No more ships will make it through tonight.", 4: '1'}

{3: 'Larsen crouched by the light strings near the gangway, his tools spread out around him. He had just finished mounting the main controller and was now bent over the code, his face set in grim concentration.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "That frown is deep enough to crush a mosquito... Sweetheart, take notes. Career planning matters. Don't end up in the wrong line of work.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Ms. Erhorn, you are an engineer yourself.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Thank you for the reminder. Am I not allowed to want better for my baby?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Then painting. You could teach her to paint. Being an artist sounds like a fine way to live.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Maybe she'll hate drawing and love singing instead. Sigh, just anything but engineering. That path ends in baldness.", 4: '1'}
{3: "The baby's face remained blank, as though quietly sighing at the conversation passing between the two fools."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "Alright, it's ready. Just... just to be clear, software isn't exactly my field. If this goes sideways... p-please don't yell at me.", 4: '1'}

{3: 'His fingers tapped across the keyboard. The light strings flared from the gentle, warm white into a harsh, blinding brightness, then dimmed slowly back to their original soft glow a few seconds later.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Power-saving mode.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "It'll run like this most of the time to save power. But when it picks up a distress signal...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He tapped the keyboard again, and the lights erupted into a violent, rhythmic flashing, like a star catching fire again and again in the night sky.'}
{3: 'Responsive brightness control, set on a loop. It could run for a long time.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'How long is a long time? Long enough for this little monster to grow up?', 4: '1'}
{3: "When Cordelia looked back down at the baby, she found the child gazing intently at the device in Larsen's hands."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Huh? Wait. Don't tell me... No interest in drawing, no interest in singing, but engineering is what gets her attention?", 4: '1'}

{3: "Cordelia lifted the baby up, a move the little one clearly did not appreciate. With a scrunched-up, grumpy face, she planted her foot squarely on Cordelia's cheek without the slightest hesitation."}
{3: 'The clumsy first-time mother had no choice but to gather her back into her arms.'}
{3: "The baby simply turned her face, pressed her ear against Cordelia's chest, and closed her eyes."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront43.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.4'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3Loading.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '10'}
{3: 'Thump. Thump. Thump.'}
{3: 'With each steady, rhythmic heartbeat, the order of life stirred and rooted itself deep inside her, growing.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront43.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.4'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3Loading.prefab', 5: '10'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Let's go inside. There's nobody left out here to save.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1509.jpg'}
{1: 'Southern Node Fenrir', 2: 'Meanwhile'}
{2: 'Meanwhile, Southern Node Fenrir'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'Deep-water temp... semiconductor cooling, buffer data, extend duration—what? None of this makes any sense!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'Would it kill you to write your notes clearly? Your handwriting was terrible back in school, and look at it now. Still a disaster...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: "I get that this is your internal tech manual or whatever, but notes are supposed to explain things to people who don't get it. So why is this written in code?", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: "So let me get this straight. I jump into the ocean with this thing, link it up with the underwater unit... and none of you thought about how I'm supposed to swim back?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The boy turned, searching for some sign of reassurance.'}
{3: 'There was only a body, pale and still.'}
{3: 'He pressed his lips together.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'Mara... the researcher stationed here, she said Fenrir goes offline in under an hour.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'No comms means no warning... When it goes offline, every node under its encryption goes naked. No alert, no protection, just exposed.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'So...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The boy patted the equipment he had never touched before.'}

{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: "She was going to stay behind. Use this thing to hold Fenrir's function, just for a while. Buy time for people who don't even know they need it. Time to escape? Or maybe just... time to prepare for death? I don't know.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: "Does it even matter? How many people are even still breathing out there, who'd need that time?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Only the silence answered him.'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'So a few of us knocked her out and hauled her onto the evac plane...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: "And I stayed! I'll do the job for her.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He said it with a triumphant grin, like a child who had just pulled off a prank.'}
{3: 'But the Fenrir node, its people either dead or fled, offered him nothing. Only the silent sea wind patted his shoulder.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1509.jpg'}
{1: '40 Minutes Before Fenrir Went Offline'}
{2: '40 Minutes Before Fenrir Went Offline'}
{3: 'He rose to his feet in that silence and walked back into the wrecked base, bustling about like a big dog finally let out for a run.'}

{3: 'He straightened toppled equipment, gathered scattered files into rough piles, and pushed crooked chairs back into place. He was not a meticulous man. He just needed to keep his hands busy in whatever time remained, even if there was not much he could do.'}
{3: 'Tucked in the corner of a storage locker, he found a handheld console. He stared at it with dead seriousness, waged an internal battle for several minutes, and then picked it up anyway.'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: "This thing can't get corrupted, right?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'Who even puts a two-player mode on something like this...', 4: '1'}
{3: "He muttered to himself, and when he realized there wasn't enough time left for even a short game, he put it back."}
{3: 'In the end, the only thing he took from the cluttered locker was a pack of instant noodles.'}
{3: 'Cooking them, this soldier who had only just become an adult began to hum, sounding impossibly cheerful.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'You can have the soup.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: "Just soup, though... I'm way too hungry to give you more than that.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: "You died with an empty stomach. I'm not doing that.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He sniffled loudly, and his voice came out a little muffled, tinged with genuine bewilderment.'}
{2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'How did you stand it? To die on an empty stomach...', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1027.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1027.jpg'}

{3: 'He pulled off his jacket and wrapped it around the body of his friend. Before the deployment, someone had told him the ocean ran bitterly cold at this time of year. His father had reminded him to eat well, to dress warmly, as if these small things could protect him.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1509.jpg'}

{3: 'Now there was nothing left to do. Only fifteen minutes before the node went dark. He lifted the equipment onto his back, paused, then shifted it forward against his chest where his eyes could always find it.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory548.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory548.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'The moon is so bright.', 4: '18'}
{3: 'He stood there staring until everything inside him felt hollow.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1312.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1312.jpg'}

{3: "Another wave of roars rose from the corrupted machines beneath the base. The moon seemed to flinch and vanished behind a bank of clouds. He turned his eyes back to his friend's body one last time, then crouched low and carved something into the wall."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1509.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1509.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Unknown Soldier', 3: 'See you in a bit, brother.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He said it with a bright smile, sounding impossibly cheerful.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: 'Splash.'}
{3: 'Heroism or fear, passion or peace, resolve or emptiness. Whatever had been in his heart, it stirred only the tiniest splash.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory548.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory548.jpg'}
{3: 'The ripples faded with terrible speed... The ocean was always like this.'}
{2: '"Did we win?"'}
{3: 'How much longer must they wait until the answer arrived?'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory936.png'}
{1: 'Command Room', 2: 'The Rainbow Bridge Base'}
{2: 'Rainbow Bridge, Command Room.'}
{3: "Last night's funeral rite left everyone without much sleep."}
{3: "Cordelia and Gunnar discussed their next steps, while Onni and Lumi still drifted in the wake of Sieg's death."}
{3: 'Everyone had believed the world might grant them a little time to mourn.'}
{3: 'But the world had never been that gentle.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiSHanshuoNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'Riiing—'}
{3: 'Alarms exploded through the base.'}
{3: 'A red beam sliced into the room, spinning and flashing, dragging every gaze toward it. The speakers tore at their ears, raw and relentless.'}
{3: "Across Cordelia's terminal, a single line of red text burned itself into view."}
{1: 'WARNING: Southern node Fenrir has gone offline.', 3: '50', 4: 'ff4e4eff'}
{2: 'WARNING: Southern node Fenrir has gone offline.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiSHanshuoNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: '...Fenrir is down. It shut itself off...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: '****! They abandoned the node?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "No. You don't voluntarily take a node offline under these conditions... It's the virus!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Fenrir is corrupted!', 4: '1'}
{3: "Cordelia's fingers flew across the holographic display before her."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "This wasn't supposed to happen... no, not this fast... these numbers...", 4: '1'}
{3: "The screen froze on a blinding wash of crimson. Cordelia's hands dropped to her side, her nails biting deep into her palms."}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'They made the right call. They held on to the very last second.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "If they hadn't shut it down, the entire Atlantic cable grid would be compromised by now. The Punishing Virus would have burned through everything.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'Goddammit. How do we even fight something like this?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "Without Fenrir's cover, the base is naked, isn't it...?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "We've been routing all our coordinate masking through that node. With it offline, our position could be completely exposed...", 4: '1'}
{3: "All the color drained from Larsen's face."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "We're already exposed... Fenrir can't attack us now that it's down, but every other corrupted base...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "Then what's the play? Every hostile on the water is about to have our number!", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "As long as the base's intercept system can still—", 4: '1'}
{3: "Cordelia was rapidly pulling up the base's status on her remote terminal when it happened."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryExplosionL.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory428.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiEnd.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory00.png'}
{3: 'A violent tremor, a blinding flash, and then silence.'}
{3: 'Everything went white. All sound vanished.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory936.png'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBranch/FxUiActivityBranchSmokeRed.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'She blinked hard, and the white gradually receded into thick, choking smoke.'}
{3: 'A hand seized Cordelia by the arm and pulled her downward, yet somehow she found herself on her feet instead.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBranch/FxUiActivityBranchSmokeRed.prefab'}
{3: 'The captain, his uniform torn and filthy, was mouthing something with frantic urgency.'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: '...can... no...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "...lia... hear me?! We've been hit!", 4: '1'}
{3: "The captain's voice, the screams, the bitter sting of smoke and scorched metal, it all crashed into Cordelia's senses at once."}
{1: '1', 3: 'She looked down in a panic and exhaled in relief. The baby was still safe in her arms, unharmed.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Missile strike! Did we lose the interceptors?!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia hurriedly checked her terminal.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: '...No. The intercept system is still online.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Fenrir was covering us, masking our coordinates, flooding their targeting with interference data.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Now that it's gone, we're wide open. Multiple corrupted nodes are firing on us at once, and we're almost dry on SAMs...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "At this rate, we'll keep taking hits. We stay here, we die.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Onni! Can you still move?', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "Just a scratch. I'm fine.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "What's the Karenin's status?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "She'll be cramped with this many bodies, but she'll sail.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Start civilian evacuation now. This base is about to turn into a shooting gallery.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'Yes, sir.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Onni turned and sprinted for the door. The moment his foot crossed the threshold, a harsh screech of grinding metal filled the air.'}
{3: 'Larsen, still sprawled on the ground, threw himself forward and hooked his leg, dragging him off his feet.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1265.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: "Onni fell backward, ready to curse him, when he saw it. The door's two massive slabs of metal were snapping shut exactly where he had stood."}
{3: 'If Larsen had been a second slower, there would have been nothing left of Onni but a smear.'}
{3: 'That door had meant to kill him.'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "The virus... it must've gotten into Frigga...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Stay clear of any smart devices! We are evacuating from Rainbow Bridge!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Gunnar pointed at the gap blasted through the wall.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory420.png'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Base Corridor'}
{2: 'Base Corridor'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: "...Understood. I'll start the civilian evacuation immediately.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'How long do we have?', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory936.png', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '11'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni (Comms)', 3: "Hard to say. The base's central system is probably already compromised.", 4: '11'}
{3: 'Bang! Bang!'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni (Comms)', 3: "Was that gunfire? What's happening on your end?", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'A maintenance robot tried to kill me. I returned the favor. The corruption has spread through the base.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni (Comms)', 3: 'Dammit... A door just tried to take me out not long ago.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'Death by a door. That would have been fitting, actually.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni (Comms)', 3: "You are unbelievable... Listen, I'm taking a squad to move the immobile wounded. Those who can still walk are on you.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'The captain and Ms. Erhorn?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni (Comms)', 3: 'On their way to central control. No telling how much time Frigga has left. Boss wants to try a manual shutdown.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'Manual...?', 4: '1'}
{3: "Lyndae's eyes suddenly widened."}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: "I'll get as many wounded aboard as I can. Go back. Find the captain. I have a bad feeling about this. Go!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 3: '11'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory983.jpg'}
{3: 'The emergency lights in the corridor flickered on and off. Cordelia and her group ran deeper into the base.'}
{3: 'When they reached a fork, Gunnar stopped abruptly.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'We split here.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Larsen. Right path, storage. Smoke signals, ropes, anything old-school. Do not touch a single piece of electronic equipment. Grab what you can and move.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Lumi. Left path, infirmary. Get medical supplies, as many as you can physically carry, and then some more. Get them to the ship, take a headcount, and report to me the second you're done. Clear?", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'The words had barely left his mouth when an explosion erupted overhead. Metal screamed in the aftermath, and the shockwave slammed into them like a wall.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Debris rained down, choking the air with dust. Cordelia flung out her hands, grabbing blindly for something to hold herself steady.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront79.png', 4: '4'}
{3: 'The moment she hit the wall, a searing bolt of pain tore through her brachial plexus, and her knees buckled beneath her.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront79.png', 4: '4', 5: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory771.jpg'}

{3: 'The ceiling split apart. A massive beam ripped through the dust and plunged downward. Old fear and the lingering damage from her modifications seized her body and mind at once, and her steps faltered for a single heartbeat.'}
{3: 'That heartbeat was enough for the shadow of the multi-ton beam to fall across her face.'}
{3: 'She clutched the child to her chest on instinct and shut her eyes.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Watch out!', 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangBegin'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'The impact slammed into her, but the expected pain never arrived. Instead, her body was hurled backward.'}
{3: 'A tremendous roar shook the very walls and rolled through the corridor like thunder.'}
{3: 'The heavy echo rang in her skull, dizzying.'}
{3: 'The floor bucked and shuddered beneath them.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: 'After what felt like an eternity, the last tremors of the shockwave finally faded.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryZhengyanNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory983.jpg'}
{3: 'Cordelia opened her eyes. The ceiling above her was nothing but a vast, ragged hole. She pushed herself upright, and only then did she see Gunnar sprawled face down on the floor before her.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Gunnar struggled to prop himself up.'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Lumi... Cough, cough... check me over...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Lumi stumbled forward to check on Gunnar. His right leg was drenched in blood from the knee down, the shin twisted at a grotesque angle.'}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: 'Sir, your leg...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Just the leg? Then I'm lucky...", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Heavy, hurried footsteps echoed down the corridor.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Corrupted machines...?!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia scrambled to her feet, bracing for whatever threat came next.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Fortunately, the figure that rounded the corner was Onni.'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'What the hell happened?!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'Boss, your leg!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'How bad is it?!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Why are you here? The ship...', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'Worry about yourself first! Lumi!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: '...Lumi, help me stop the bleeding. Splint it enough so I can walk.', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: "Yes, sir. I'll do what I can...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "Forget about it! I'm carrying you to the ship! Let's go!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Lumi, splint it!', 4: '2'}
{3: "Gunnar's tone turned grave without warning."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'My orders have not changed. Get the civilians aboard. Gather the supplies. Carry out your orders!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'And what about you?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Another volley of fire shook the ground, another surge of violent trembling. This time, thankfully, the impact struck farther away.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Ms. Erhorn, if Karenin is at full speed, can she clear the base's firing range before the central system is fully compromised?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'In that instant, Cordelia understood everything.'}
{3: 'Why Gunnar sent Larsen and Lumi away. Why he wanted to speak with her alone.'}
{3: 'Gunnar had already made his decision.'}
{3: 'She closed her eyes and gave a slow shake of her head.'}
{3: 'Onni looked from Cordelia to Captain Gunnar, whose face had gone pale from blood loss.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'The hell is this? Boss, what are you playing at?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'This is why I have to stay.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'A corrupted base turns its guns on every coordinate on the map. No discrimination. No mercy. I will not let that happen here.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Rainbow Bridge's batteries, firing on my own waters...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Not while I'm still breathing.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "What's your plan?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Give me the Erhorn key. Your key, plus my palm print. It's the only way to sink this base.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'The self-destruct was built for a reason. This is the reason.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Lumi, don't waste time on pretty work. Just get me functional enough to reach the control room...", 4: '1'}
{3: "The medic's face went pale, but she began to carry out her commander's orders."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "Bind it tight, Lumi! Don't let him move that leg!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Do I need to remind you what the word "discipline" means?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Called out by rank, the young man clenched his jaw so hard the veins stood out along his temples and cheeks.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Lieutenant Onni, do you have a better plan? Are you more qualified than a captain, a marine engineer, or Ms. Erhorn?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'If not, then rein it in. You are still a soldier. These kids are going to need you when this is over.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Onni said nothing more. Lumi kept her head lowered, her hands still moving.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Is there no other way, Ms. Erhorn?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "We've survived everything up to now. There must be something else we can do...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia said nothing. She gave no response to Gunnar, and she had no answer for Larsen.'}
{3: "She simply stared into Gunnar's eyes, searching desperately for even the faintest trace of reluctance."}

{3: 'If she could find just a flicker of hesitation there, she would gladly shoulder that sin herself and play the selfish villain, if that was what it took to drag this man determined to die onto the ship.'}
{3: 'The child, who had been utterly silent through the earlier blast, suddenly let out a small, soft whimper.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'You just saved me... and this child...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Then you'd better live. Don't waste the life I just pulled you back into.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Going down with the base... that one's mine.", 4: '1'}
{3: "She found no softness in his gaze. She had known she wouldn't."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "Commander Gunnar, you told us... only warriors who fall in battle are taken by the Valkyries. If you die like this... you won't reach Valhalla. Commander Gunnar—", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Hahahahahaha.', 4: '2'}
{3: "The poet's clumsy, earnest attempt to convince him drew a deep, genuine laugh from Gunnar."}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Go now, all of you.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Cordelia took a deep breath and rose to her feet.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Lumi, finish quickly... We have to go.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Wait, there has to be another way. Ms. Erhorn—', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'There is no other way!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She forced down the sob rising in her throat and transferred the key to Gunnar.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "I've got nothing else.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Lumi... don't fear the sea. When you graduate, I want you to have a bright life ahead of you.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Larsen... the old stories of our ancestors are dying out. Be the one who keeps them. Tell ours too, while you're at it.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Onni... you little bastard. Stop fighting with Lyndae.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Unlike the two younger ones, whose eyes had already brimmed with tears, Onni merely pressed his lips together in a thin line. And somehow, that put Gunnar at ease.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "Ms. Erhorn, I'm placing them in your care.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "From this moment on, you're the captain.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Gunnar extended his hand, and Cordelia grasped it with a tight, steady grip.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Larsen, Lumi, Onni. You heard the old captain. Gather supplies. Get the civilians out... Let's move.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia pulled Larsen and Lumi away, leaving Onni still standing there.'}
{3: "He took Gunnar's weight onto his shoulder and asked for the last confirmation."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "So you're really not going home, boss? All that talk about fish and snow. None of it meant a thing?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "None of it. I'm not going home, Onni... And I won't be going to Valhalla either.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The realm of the gods had fallen into waste, but the warships of the mortals still had to sail on.'}
{3: 'Captain Gunnar let out a soft laugh, the smell of blood on his breath.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'This is my warship right here.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: '...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: "I'll see you off.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory978.jpg'}
{3: 'Onni carried Gunnar on his back to the upper level of the central control room.'}
{3: "Gunnar reached into his shirt pocket, pulled out his last cigarette, and tucked it into Onni's tactical pouch. He patted Onni's chest once, then turned and stepped into the elevator."}
{3: 'They parted without another word.'}
{3: "Before Gunnar's silhouette had even vanished behind the closing metal doors, Onni was already sprinting toward the dock. Something left him forever in that moment."}
{3: 'And something stronger took root in his heart.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1316.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiSHanshuoNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'The entire base throbbed with an ominous red light, shadows flickering like phantoms. It was impossible to tell anymore whether the glow came from the alarms or the eyes of corrupted machines.'}
{3: 'The shock of the explosions and the screams echoing from every direction left Ausias dazed.'}
{3: 'Blood trickled slowly down his forehead. The blast must have caught him in the head.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ausias', 3: 'Aeris... my little snowflake...', 4: '1'}
{3: "Murmuring his daughter's name, the seasoned sailor slapped both cheeks hard to pull himself together."}
{2: 'Ausias', 3: 'Got to get home to her...', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiSHanshuoNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A scream cut through the chaos, and Ausias rushed forward. At the far end of the corridor, a woman clutching a child stumbled toward him.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Behind her, two service robots lurched in pursuit.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab'}
{3: 'Ausias charged ahead and caught the woman just before she collapsed.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ausias', 3: 'Are you hurt? Quick, to the ship—', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The words died in his throat. His hand came away wet and sticky with blood, a sensation he had grown far too familiar with these past days.'}
{3: 'There was too much blood. She was covered in it. That she had made it this far was nothing short of a miracle.'}
{3: 'The woman shook her head in agony.'}
{3: 'Then, she cast one last longing look at the little girl in the red dress cradled in her arms before turning to Ausias with desperate eyes.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Young Mother', 3: "I'm not going to... make it... Please... she's still so small...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The corrupted machines were closing in fast.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Young Mother', 3: "Save my child. Just get her on board... That's all I ask...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The child felt so light in his arms, and it brought back memories of his own daughter when she was small.'}
{2: 'Ausias', 3: 'You have my word.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He did not linger, nor did he offer any comfort. Ausias held the girl tight, turned, and ran away.'}
{3: 'The young mother watched his back, a thin smile crossing her lips.'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory420.png'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: 'Ausias ran with everything he had, rounding corner after corner.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory418.jpg'}
{3: 'After all his years working there, he had never realized how vast the base truly was. It felt endless, like there was no way out.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory109.png'}
{3: 'Floor cleaners, automatic doors, charging stations, even the water dispensers, every machine he passed wanted him dead.'}
{3: 'Blood from his forehead seeped into his eyes as he ran. His head swam, heavier with each step, and he had no idea how much longer he could last.'}
{3: "The child in his arms kept whimpering. Each time she called for her mother, something clenched tight in Ausias' chest."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Disable'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory419.jpg'}

{3: 'Around the next corner, he ran into a young girl in uniform. Her back was drenched in blood, and she was dragging a huge medical case behind her. He recognized her. She was the young medic who served under the captain.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: "One of the mad robots clipped me. It's nothing.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lumi', 3: "I have to get these supplies to the ship... Sir, go ahead. I'll manage.", 4: '2'}
{1: '3', 3: "Ausias placed the girl into Lumi's arms and hoisted the heavy case onto his shoulders."}
{2: 'Ausias', 3: "You take her. I've got the muscle for this.", 4: '15'}
{3: 'Lumi nodded, and the two of them started running again.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory419.jpg'}

{3: "The medical case was impossibly heavy. The dizziness swelled in Ausias' skull until the world dissolved into pale light and drifting silhouettes. It felt as though the girl had emptied the entire infirmary into that case, determined to haul it to the ship on her own."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1579.jpg'}
{3: 'They pushed through the mangled remains of several fire doors and finally emerged outside.'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}

{3: 'The wind howled. Gunfire cracked through the air. Outside was even more chaotic than within. Soldiers and civilians were pressed together in a frantic knot, fighting off wave after wave of Corrupted.'}

{3: "The wind bit into the wound on her back, siphoning away what little warmth she had left. The dock was still far, and Lumi's knees trembled uncontrollably. Against the endless tide of Corrupted, she knew she would not make it that far."}
{3: 'Cordelia and Larsen came running up from behind. Cordelia had the baby strapped to her back, her arms full of supplies. Larsen was hauling an entire crate of provisions.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "There are too many of them... We can't make it to the ship...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Stop that. Lumi, put the girl down.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'The girl began shaking the moment her feet touched the ground. She stared at the chaos unfolding around her, her eyes hollow and blank.'}
{3: "Her mother was still somewhere back in the base. She didn't know where to look or who to turn to."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Hold the baby!', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'From this moment until you see me again, your job is to protect her. That is your mission. Do you understand?', 4: '1'}
{3: "Cordelia lifted the baby from her back and placed the infant gently into the little girl's arms. Something shifted in those hollow, vacant eyes. Focus returned at last."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Girl in a Red Dress', 3: 'Hold... the baby... mission...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Run. Straight to the ship. Don't look back. Get on board, find a place to hide, and wait for me.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'The little girl nodded.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Larsen, Lumi. The three of us will force a path up front. Sir, stay behind us and keep your eyes on that child.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ausias', 3: 'Engineer, let me take that too.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Ausias took Larsen's crate and slung it over his back, then hoisted the huge medical case onto his shoulder."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: "Get ready. Let's go!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Cordelia and the other two hurled themselves into the crowd, forcing open a narrow gap.'}
{3: 'Someone shouted, "Children coming through! Make way!" and a razor-thin seam flickered open among the bodies.'}
{3: 'The little girl, clutching the baby to her chest, dove into that sliver of space and vanished from sight.'}
{3: 'The remaining four adults crawled through the web of limbs, and Cordelia snatched a fallen gun from the ground and joined the fight against the Corrupted.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Move! Keep moving! To the ship!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieDao.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}

{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieDao.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'Someone collapsed beside him. Larsen snatched the metal pipe from their grip and swung it at the oncoming Corrupted.'}
{3: 'Lumi shielded herself with her arms and inched forward through the crowd.'}
{3: 'One figure fell, and another stepped up to take their place. In that long, desperate path of bodies, no one seemed willing to abandon the rest and save themselves alone.'}
{3: 'Young faces, familiar faces, faces she could not name, all stood against the Corrupted so that others could reach the ship.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1603.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1603.jpg'}
{3: 'At last, Lumi spotted the long gangway. Beside it, Lyndae and the soldiers had formed two lines, the final wall between the Corrupted and the vessel.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: "Get on board! Squad Two, two o'clock, cover fire!", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory598.jpg'}
{3: 'Under the cover of suppressing fire, Lumi finally pushed free of the crowd, and a wave of relief unlike anything she had ever felt washed over her.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lumi', 3: "Sir! Sir! We made it! We're safe!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Lumi looked back. Twenty paces behind her, the two large supply crates lay toppled on the ground.'}
{3: 'The burly sailor was slumped over them, long past saving.'}
{3: 'The surging crowd and the encroaching Corrupted swallowed his body the next moment.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1603.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Gangway', 2: 'Base Dock'}
{2: 'Base Dock, Gangway.'}
{3: "Carried by the surge of bodies, Cordelia and Larsen at last arrived at the ship's side."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Is everyone here?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: "No time for a count. If they can still move, they're here.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: "But the Karenin hasn't finished its inspection. She's not supposed to sail yet...", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: "We're out of time. Prepare for departure. Sound the horn!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: '****, screw it all!', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Lyndae made a gesture, and the ship answered with a long, mournful blast that rolled through the dock. It was the signal to depart.'}
{3: 'The mass of people drew inward, converging on the gangway. The horn seemed to madden the Corrupted, sending them into a wilder, more desperate frenzy.'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: 'As the crowd withdrew up the gangway, the defensive line tightened, and the suppressing fire grew more concentrated and effective.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1603.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1603.jpg'}
{3: "More and more survivors climbed to the safety of the ship's cabins. Onni appeared among the last of the crowd, leading his squad to join the fight."}
{1: '1', 3: 'But a new problem quickly became clear. For every step the survivors retreated upward, the relentless Corrupted took one as well. At this rate, they would soon reach the deck.'}
{3: 'A new deadlock.'}
{3: 'Before Cordelia could even begin to think of a solution, someone broke it.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Survivor B', 3: 'Go! Just ****ing go!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab'}

{3: 'One by one, the survivors who understood what had to be done leaped from the gangway and threw themselves into the horde of Corrupted, their bodies the only wall left against the mechanical tide.'}
{3: 'The soldiers formed a line and leveled their rifles like a barricade, bracing for the twisted machines to crash against them.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Base Soldier', 3: 'Aaarghhhh!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He drove into the enemy before him and surged forward, toward the dark open sea.'}
{3: 'One after another, they plunged into the icy sea, their bodies the final signal.'}
{3: 'On the wind, her voice broke like a sob.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1578.jpg'}
{3: 'The engines bellowed, and the horn howled as the ship tore away from the dock, severing the gangway and sending countless figures plunging into the dark sea.'}
{3: 'With the sacrifice of the nameless heroes, the ship was finally underway.'}
{3: 'The great beast of steel groaned as it pulled free of the port, and Lyndae, who had just begun to breathe again, suddenly realized something.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: "Where's the captain? Where is Captain Gunnar?", 4: '1'}
{3: "Onni wouldn't meet her eyes."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'Onni? I told you to go back for him. I told you I had a bad feeling. I told you he was going to get himself killed!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Lyndae', 3: 'You left him there? Onni! You piece of ****!', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}

{3: 'She bolted forward, straight to the railing. One foot came up onto the rail, her body tipping over the edge toward the freezing dark water below, where the bodies of fallen comrades bobbed among the shrieking Corrupted.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1578.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1578.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'Onni seized her by the collar from behind, hauled her up, and threw her into the cabin despite her furious curses, slamming the door shut.'}
{3: 'He leaned back against the door and pulled the cigarette from his pouch, holding it between his fingers. On the other side of the door, the cursing crumbled into raw, helpless wailing.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lieutenant Junior Grade Onni', 3: 'See, Captain? No fighting, just like you asked...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Beneath the dark clouds, Onni stared at the cigarette, his mind far away.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory936.png'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Central Control Room', 2: 'The Rainbow Bridge Base'}
{2: 'Rainbow Bridge, Central Control Room.'}
{3: 'The bombardment did not relent, and the control room trembled endlessly around him.'}
{3: "Gunnar pulled himself to the console, his broken leg dragging behind. The ship's horn had sounded moments ago."}
{3: 'He entered the key sequence, pressed his palm flat, and a hidden drawer in the desk slid free, exposing a row of black levers waiting inside.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Alright, time to go.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He pulled the first lever.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory771.jpg'}

{3: 'The sector of gun batteries was the first to break apart and sink. Turrets, missile silos, depth charge launchers, the iron fangs that had once guarded these waters. Now they all plunged into the darkness below, their long, mournful groans echoing through the air.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory936.png'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: 'Our turn.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He pulled the second lever, and the central control room convulsed in response. Gunnar leaned his trembling body against the console, fighting to stay on his feet.'}

{3: "His fingers reached for the third lever. The residential area. Somewhere in that section lay the last backup branch of Frigga, the base's central AI. Once the central control descended into the deep with the base, this fragile copy, designed only for brief independent function, would never stir again."}
{1: 'Should he sink it with everything else?', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffffff'}
{2: 'Should he sink it with everything else?'}
{1: 'There could be people still in the living quarters...', 3: '50', 4: 'ffffffff'}
{2: 'There could be people still in the living quarters...'}
{3: 'In a situation this hopeless, no one left behind could possibly survive much longer. Gunnar knew this, and yet his hand passed over the third lever without touching it.'}

{3: "The central area sank slowly, and freezing seawater began to seep through every crack in the room. Gunnar's hand trembled against the console. He reached for his last cigarette, then remembered he had given it to Onni when they parted."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1281.jpg'}

{3: 'The water was as cold as Helheim itself, the realm of Hel, goddess of the dead. The cold did not settle on the skin. It grew from inside the bones, ice needles driving through marrow, draining his life away with each passing moment.'}
{3: 'He forced his eyes open and stared into the dark water pressing down around him. Green, bottomless, vast... Of all things, somehow, his mind turned to the sky above his homeland now.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1089.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1089.jpg'}

{3: "In his daze, thick snow filled his vision, and the sound of a ship's horn poured into his ears, again and again. His young lover came running toward him with an armful of flowers, her cheeks flushed, her breath a warm cloud in the frozen air."}
{3: 'Flowers that vivid were a rare sight in the polar cold, and he wondered how long she must have searched for them.'}

{3: "The scent of those blooms had long since faded from his memory, but he still remembered how good his mother's fried fish had tasted. Nothing, anywhere, had ever been better than the fish back home."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory936.png'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "It's so cold...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The snow of home. The fish of home. The bone-cold waters of home.'}
{3: 'That freezing sea cradled him now, drawing him into an eternal sleep, while his young lover called to him from the far side of time.'}
{3: 'What was she calling out...?'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Captain Gunnar', 3: "(Helheim's ferry comes too fast. I can't make out the words...)", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: 'The warrior closed his eyes.'}
{3: 'The structures groaned and ground against each other, a chorus of collapsing steel. The sound rolled through the water like the roar of a festival crowd.'}
